scripts.build: tsc && vite build && esbuild src/miniapp-bridge.ts --minify --bundle --outfile=dist/miniapp-bridge.min.js && npm run build:web3-runtime
scripts.test: esbuild src/index.ts src/miniapp-bridge.ts src/injected/*.ts src/hooks/*.ts src/__tests__/*.test.ts --outdir=dist-test --format=esm --platform=node && node --test dist-test/__tests__/*.test.js
scripts.postinstall: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; const root = path.resolve('..'); try { fs.cpSync(path.join(root, 'node_modules/@types'), path.resolve('node_modules/@types'), { recursive: true }); } catch (e) {} try { fs.cpSync(path.join(root, 'node_modules/@types'), path.resolve('../packages/appservice/node_modules/@types'), { recursive: true }); } catch (e) {} try { if (!fs.existsSync(path.resolve('../packages/appservice/node_modules/typescript'))) { fs.symlinkSync(path.join(root, 'node_modules/typescript'), path.resolve('../packages/appservice/node_modules/typescript'), 'dir'); } } catch (e) {}"
